title: G'raha Tia — Throw Wide the Gates

Teferi, Hero of Dominaria.text: Planeswalker: "+1: Draw a card… untap up to two lands" refunds mana for a second spell; "−3" tucks any nonland permanent (r1, r9); MV5 trigger is optional (r4)

Absorb.text: Instant hard counter plus "You gain 3 life", which repays the X=3 Hero it makes on the opponent's turn (r2, r4, r5, r9)

Ojutai's Command.text: Instant: "Counter target creature spell" or "Draw a card" plus "You gain 4 life", which pays for its own 5/5 Hero; can reanimate a MV≤2 creature (r2, r5)

Azorius Charm.text: Instant MV2: tuck an attacker/blocker on top of its library, or draw, or team lifelink; the lifelink mode turns a Hero swing into life fuel (r2, r4, r5, r9)

Detention Sphere.text: Exiles any nonland permanent, and every token sharing its name; MV3 noncreature (r1, r4, r9); sorcery speed only

Pull of the Mist Moon.text: O-ring enchantment, "exile target nonland permanent"; the kicker perpetually grants a second O-ring to a card in hand (r1, r4, r9)

Biorganic Carapace.text: Equipment, auto-attaches; draws "a card for each modified creature" and every Hero token arrives carrying counters, so they are all modified (r1, r6)

Metropolis Angel.text: "Whenever you attack with one or more creatures with counters on them, draw a card": every Hero token has counters, so it draws each combat (r6)

Spider-Woman, Secret Agent.text: Flash Hero; locks down a creature "for as long as you control Spider-Woman", so it is instant-speed interaction (r9); enables Hylda/Sharae taps

Twining Twins // Swift Spiral.text: *Adventure "Swift Spiral" is an MV2 instant, a noncreature cast on either turn (r1, r2); it blinks a nontoken creature to save it, then a 4-MV flier

Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the.text: Back face: "You may cast spells as though they had flash", so EVERY noncreature spell can trigger the commander on the opponent's turn (r2); {U/P} costs 2 life (r5)

Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous.text: Extort on "Whenever you cast a spell" drains 1 per spell, which refills the life the commander spends (r5); lifelink plus the commander flips him; −1 burns

Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dea.text: Shaile puts a counter on "each creature that entered… this turn", which includes the turn's Hero token; Embrose pings 2 and draws when a countered creature dies (r6)

Cid, Timeless Artificer.text: "Artifact creatures and Heroes you control get +1/+1 for each Artificer", an anthem for every Hero token (r6); any number of copies are legal; cycling

Aven Wind Guide.text: "Creature tokens you control have flying and vigilance": every Hero token becomes an evasive attacker that can still block (r6)

Denzilore Fatehold.text: Flash flier; "Whenever you scry or surveil, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature" grows the Hero tokens (r6), but the scry count in this part is thin (Runic Shot kicker, Niko Shards)

Gold-Forged Thopteryx.text: 2-mana flying lifelink (r5); "Each legendary permanent you control has ward {2}" protects the commander

Spider-Woman, Stunning Savior.text: 2-mana flying Hero with hybrid {W/U}; opposing creatures "enter tapped", buying a turn for the life-paying plan

Faithful Mending.text: Instant: "gain 2 life, draw two, then discard two", and flashback is a second noncreature cast later (r1, r2, r5); card-neutral filtering

Runic Shot.text: "Destroy target tapped creature": anything that attacked you last turn is still tapped on your turn; MV1 makes only a 2/2 (r4, r9)

Protect the Negotiators.text: Instant soft counter that taxes "{1} for each creature you control", and Hero tokens raise the tax; kicker adds a Soldier (r2, r6, r9)

Hindering Light.text: Instant "Counter target spell that targets you or a permanent you control. Draw a card." protects the commander and the token board (r2)

Staggering Insight.text: Aura: lifelink plus "draw a card" on combat damage; put it on an evasive Hero token for life fuel (r1, r5); aura risk applies

Pearl Collector.text: Deathtouch and lifelink; with 4+ life gained it conjures Mox Pearl, an MV0 noncreature cast that makes a free 1/1 Hero (r1, r5)

Benalish Sleeper.text: Kicked: "each player sacrifices a creature", and a 1/1 Hero token is the cheap sacrifice, so it is a one-sided edict (r6, r9)

Rodolf Duskbringer.text: Flying, deathtouch, lifelink 6-drop; reanimates MV≤"life gained this turn", and the commander's lifelink sets that number (r5)

Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier.text: Flying lifelink body (r5); Isilu gives "nontoken" creatures persist, so the Hero tokens get nothing; convoke only helps creature spells

King T'Challa // Black Panther, Hope End.text: Flash Hero; "Whenever a player draws their second card each turn, you draw", which pairs with the draw spells in this part (Mending, Charm, Teferi)

Malcator, Purity Overseer.text: 3 mana for two bodies (a 3/3 Golem artifact token); Cid pumps artifact creatures; the end-step clause rarely fires

Hylda of the Icy Crown.text: "Whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls", pay {1} for a 4/4, team counters or a card; needs the tap package (Spider-Woman SA, Sharae)

Sharae of Numbing Depths.text: ETB tap plus stun counter (tempo interaction); draws "once each turn" when you tap their creatures, which overlaps with Hylda

Niko, Light of Hope.text: Two Shard enchantment tokens (scry 1, draw); the copy ability can't target tokens' value well. Shards feed Denzilore's scry (r6)

Narset Transcendent.text: +1 takes "a noncreature, nonland card", a hit rate that rises with r3 density; −2 rebound recasts an instant on your upkeep, which uses that turn's trigger (r1)

Invasion of Xerex // Vertex Paladin.text: A Battle is a noncreature cast (r1); the ETB bounce is tempo; it flips to a flier sized by "the number of creatures you control", which Hero tokens grow

Errant and Giada.text: Flash flier; cast "spells with flash or flying" from the top, but instants do not have flash, so it does not reach the noncreature core (r3)

Superior Spider-Man.text: Hero clone of "any creature card in a graveyard" (either yard); value depends on what has died; creature slot (r3)

Symbiote Spider-Man.text: Hybrid Hero; combat-damage dig; Find New Host is an activation, not a cast, but it can put its abilities on a Hero token from the graveyard (r6)

Senate Guildmage.text: "{W},{T}: You gain 2 life" repays an X=2 Hero every turn (r5) but costs mana and a tap; slow

Skycat Sovereign.text: Flier lord counts "other creature you control with flying"; it scales only with Aven Wind Guide making Hero tokens fly (r6)

Will, Scion of Peace.text: Sorcery-speed tap: W/U spells cost X less "where X is the amount of life you gained this turn"; the commander's lifelink sets X; it needs combat first

Lavinia, Azorius Renegade.text: A hoser against cheated and free spells and the opponent's big noncreature spells; it does not restrict you; meta-dependent (r9)

Kels, Fight Fixer.text: Draws "whenever you sacrifice a creature", and Hero tokens are fodder, but the sac outlet is only "{1}, Sacrifice: indestructible" (r6)

Shilgengar, Sire of Famine.text: Sacrifices Hero tokens for Blood; six Blood reanimates the whole yard; slow and grindy, and it eats the board the commander built

Bard the Bowman.text: "draw your second card each turn": a counter plus lifelink, which needs a draw spell every turn to fire

Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker.text: Flier that grows on opponent spells; partner is irrelevant under G'raha; a plain beater

Sun-Spider, Nimble Webber.text: Hero that tutors "an Aura or Equipment card" for Biorganic Carapace or Staggering Insight; the value depends on that package's size

Taigam, Ojutai Master.text: Rebound needs "Taigam attacked this turn"; the rebound cast lands in YOUR upkeep, which spends that turn's once-each-turn trigger (r1, r2)

Black Widow, Double Agent.text: Deathtouch Hero; "attacks alone" grants first strike plus menace, which works against a go-wide Hero-token board (r6)

Captain America, Living Legend.text: Untaps creatures first tapped "during your turn", a team-vigilance effect for Hero tokens; a soft effect on a creature slot (r3)

Brokers' Safeguard.text: Instant MV2 noncreature (r2), but it blinks a creature to protect it, and a blinked Hero TOKEN is exiled and gone; nontoken creatures only

Hallowed Respite.text: A sorcery blink that kills your own Hero tokens and resets their counters; it only taps an opposing creature; flashback is a second cast (r1)

Rona, Herald of Invasion // Rona, Tolari.text: A looter that untaps on "a legendary spell"; the back face costs 6; few legendary noncreature spells in this part

Taeko, the Patient Avalanche.text: It grows when creatures leave "if it didn't die" (blink and bounce); enters tapped; the unblockable clause has a cost

Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit.text: "gain 1 life" on each death; small lifegain fuel (r5) but a weak body

Battlewise Hoplite.text: Heroic needs "a spell that targets this creature", and this part has few targeted own-creature spells (Insight, Safeguard)

Jubilant Skybonder.text: Taxes targeting of your fliers by {2}, which helps only if Hero tokens fly (Aven Wind Guide); a weak body

Ace Flockbringer.text: Triggers on "a creature spell without flying", which pulls the deck toward creatures, the opposite of r3

Lo and Li, Royal Advisors.text: Mill grows only Advisors (itself); blind mill is a clock, not interaction (G-62)

Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset.text: PW cast = 5/5 Hero for 4 life (r1/r4); "+1 … You gain 2 life" refunds half the payment (r5); −2 card selection; sorcery-speed only

War Machine, James Rhodes.text: Is a Hero but pays off nothing; "Whenever War Machine attacks, tap up to one target creature" is a fine evasive 4-drop, creature (r1 no bonus)

Don & Leo, Problem Solvers.text: End-step blink of "a creature you control" would EXILE a Hero token for good (tokens cease to exist); it's optional ("up to one"), but the only good target is your own creature

Ezrim, Agency Chief.text: "investigate twice" = 2 Clues, and cracking them is not a cast; WWUU 5-drop creature, can gain lifelink by sacrificing an artifact (r5), off-engine

Quintorius, Fate Splitter.text: 6/6 Hero on cast (r1); "0: Proliferate. You gain 3 life" grows EVERY Hero token and refills life (r5/r6); −3 makes a token and puts a counter on each creature

SP//dr, Piloted by Peni.text: "Whenever a modified creature you control deals combat damage … draw a card": every Hero token carries counters, so they all count as modified (r6, density from the commander)

Tura Kennerüd, Skyknight.text: "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1": stacks with G'raha off the same spells, but it's a 5-drop creature and misses PWs, auras and battles

Azor, the Lawbringer.text: The attack trigger pays {X}{W}{U}{U} for "gain X life and draw X" (r5), but it's a 6-MV creature that has to survive to attack; no help to the engine

Banish into Fable.text: Instant bounce + Knight, so it works on the opponent's turn (r2); copies off artifact/enchantment; MV 6 = a 7/7 for 6 life, so usually decline (r4)

Dovin, Architect of Law.text: "+1: You gain 2 life and draw a card" is a life+card engine (r5); −1 taps a creature (tempo); 6 MV makes the Hero cost 6 life (r4)

Gwaihir the Windlord.text: 6-MV flier; the discount needs two draws in a turn and the Bird clause is dead; nothing for the engine

Restricted Office // Lecture Hall.text: FIGHTS ENGINE: "destroy all creatures with power 3 or greater" kills your own Heroes (the X=3 token from casting it is 4/4); Lecture Hall's unlock is not a cast

Invasion of New Phyrexia // Teferi Akosa.text: "create X 2/2 … Knight tokens": the stack MV is X+2, so X=3 gives 3 Knights + a 6/6 Hero (r4/r6), go-wide; flips into a PW

Sphinx's Revelation.text: Instant, so cast it at the opponent's end step for a second token (r2); "You gain X life" refunds most of the X+3 payment (r5); card draw too

Abigale, Eloquent First-Year.text: ETB on a Hero token loses nothing (tokens have no text) and gains flying/first strike/LIFELINK counters (r5/r6); a 2-drop lifelink body itself

Ayli, Eternal Pilgrim.text: "Sacrifice another creature: You gain life equal to … toughness": a spent X+1 Hero refunds the payment (r5); exile mode needs 35 life in Brawl

Arvad, Weatherlight Smuggler.text: 2-drop deathtouch+lifelink (r5); the perpetual growth needs deaths (sac outlets in this part)

Cleric of Life's Bond.text: "first time each turn" gain → +1/+1 counter; a small body, and the Cleric clause is narrow

Consecrate // Consume.text: Consecrate is an INSTANT (MV 2) with gy hate + draw, a 3/3 on the opp's turn (r2/r4); Consume (MV 4) is an edict + "gain life equal to its power" (r5/r9)

Dark Leo & Shredder.text: Ninja payoff with no Ninja density; Hero tokens aren't Ninjas

Cruel Celebrant.text: Drain 1 on each death (r5): only as good as the sac-outlet count

Despark.text: Instant exile for "mana value 4 or greater" (r9), MV 2, so a 3/3 for 2 on the opp's turn (r2/r4); narrow targets

Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord.text: Gain 1 on each death; the sac outlet can turn spent Heroes into counters; aristocrats glue

Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim.text: "Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life": every Hero token refunds 1 (r5); drain on death

Feast of the Victorious Dead.text: Noncreature MV 2 → 3/3 (r1); the end-step gain + counters needs a death that turn (r6)

Fleshtaker.text: Sac outlet: gain 1 + scry 1 per sac; low impact

Fracture.text: Instant "Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker", MV 2, so a 3/3 on the opp's turn (r2/r9)

Frodo, Adventurous Hobbit.text: "if you gained 3 or more life this turn": G'raha's lifelink turns this on; the Ring is slow value

General's Enforcer.text: "Legendary Humans … indestructible": few targets here; the gy-exile ability makes a token, but it's expensive

Golden Sidekick.text: Flying lifelink 2-drop (r5); the perpetual pump only reaches creature cards in hand, and this deck is spell-heavy

Hashaton, Scarab's Fist.text: Needs "discard a creature card": no discard engine here

Head of the Class.text: Spells that target a creature "cost {W}{B} less": a cost cut keeps the MV, so the token is unchanged (r4); Repartee grows it

Humiliate.text: Sorcery hand attack + "+1/+1 counter on a creature you control" (on a Hero, r6); MV 2 → 3/3

Invasion of New Capenna // Holy Frazzle-.text: Battle removal (sacrifice a spent Hero) (r9); back-face equip puts a counter on "each other creature … that shares a creature type": every Hero token (r6)

Killian, Ink Duelist.text: Lifelink menace 2-drop (r5); "cost {2} less" cuts the price, not the MV, so removal makes the same-size Hero for less mana (r4)

Rite of Oblivion.text: "sacrifice a nonland permanent" (a spent 1/1 Hero) to exile any nonland permanent; Flashback is a second CAST → second trigger (r1/r9)

Revival // Revenge.text: Revenge (MV 6): "Double your life total" is the biggest life refill here (r5); Revival (MV 2) reanimates MV ≤3

Sandbender Scavengers.text: Grows on each sacrifice; the death trigger reanimates; needs a sac density this part only half provides

Syr Vondam, Sunstar Exemplar.text: Counter + gain 1 on each death/exile (r5/r6); at 4+ power its death destroys a nonland permanent

Anguished Unmaking.text: Instant "Exile target nonland permanent", MV 3 → 4/4 Hero on either turn (r2/r4/r9); the 3 life is the only cost

Athreos, God of Passage.text: A God is a creature card off the battlefield, so this is a CREATURE spell (no trigger); returning dead creatures misses tokens; rarely a creature

Gift of Orzhova.text: Aura MV 3 → 4/4 Hero (r1), then "flying and lifelink" on that Hero turns it into a life engine (r5/r6); aura risk

Hardened Tactician.text: "{1}, Sacrifice a token: Draw a card": a spent Hero token becomes a card (r6)

Indulging Patrician.text: Flying lifelink; "if you gained 3 or more life this turn, each opponent loses 3": G'raha's lifelink helps hit it (r5)

Kambal, Consul of Allocation.text: Taxes the OPPONENT's noncreature spells (drain 2) (r5); a matchup card, not engine

Kambal, Profiteering Mayor.text: "Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1": fires off each Hero (r5/r6); copies their tokens

Karai, Future of the Foot.text: Combat-damage recursion; the sneak line wants unblocked attackers; off-engine

Kaya, Geist Hunter.text: PW → 4/4 Hero; "+1: … +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature token" (r6); "−2: … twice that many … tokens" doubles the next Hero

Kunoros, Hound of Athreos.text: Vigilance/menace/lifelink body (r5), but "can't cast spells from graveyards" kills your own Rite flashback and Revival/Karai/Sandbender

Mortify.text: Instant "Destroy target creature or enchantment", MV 3 → 4/4 Hero, on either turn (r2/r9)

Nalia de'Arnise.text: Full-party clause: Hero tokens aren't party classes; play-from-top only for 4 classes

Ruthless Lawbringer.text: "sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target nonland permanent": a spent Hero buys removal (r9)

Silverquill Pledgemage.text: Magecraft grants flying or lifelink for the turn; a weak 3-drop body

Snooping Page.text: Repartee unblockable + draw on hit; needs targeted instants/sorceries

Tomik, Wielder of Law.text: Flying vigilance; in 1v1, when they attack with two or more creatures: drain 3 + draw; affinity for planeswalkers

Tymna the Weaver.text: Lifelink; "pay X life … draw X cards" at most 1 per turn in 1v1, and Hero tokens connecting enable it (r5)

Aryel, Knight of Windgrace.text: Activated Knight tokens + "Destroy target creature with power X or less"; pairs with Invasion of New Phyrexia's Knights

Baron Bertram Graywater.text: "tokens … enter, create a 1/1 … Vampire Rogue … with lifelink" once per turn: every Hero gives an extra lifelink body (r5/r6); sac → draw

Barrensteppe Siege.text: Abzan "+1/+1 counter on each creature you control" every end step grows every Hero token (r6); Mardu edict if tokens trade; MV4 sweet spot (r4)

Drana and Linvala.text: Flying vigilance body that shuts off opposing creatures' activated abilities and steals them; creature, so no trigger (r1) — graded on hate value

Elenda, the Dusk Rose.text: Lifelink (r5) and "whenever another creature dies, +1/+1 counter" — chump-blocking Heroes grow her; death leaves lifelink tokens

Elenda, Saint of Dusk.text: Bonus needs "life total greater than your starting life total" — fights the X-life payments the deck makes every turn (r5); lifelink only

Ondu Knotmaster // Throw a Line.text: Throw a Line is a MV2 sorcery cast = trigger (r1,r4) distributing counters; later a lifelinker that grows when a modified (countered) Hero dies (r6)

Seething Skitter-Priest.text: Mite-on-death grant is perpetual only to creatures present/in hand at ETB, so future Hero tokens miss it; toxic 1 off-plan; creature (r1)

Splinter, Radical Rat.text: Doubles triggers of NINJA creatures only; the deck has no Ninjas and Heroes aren't Ninjas (r6 count = 0)

Diviner of Fates.text: ETB connive + "seek a card that shares a type" once per turn on discard; filter body, no engine tie, creature (r1)

Nimble Larcenist.text: 3-MV flyer whose ETB exiles an artifact/instant/sorcery from their hand — proactive disruption (r9), creature so no trigger

Void Rend.text: Instant "destroy target nonland permanent", can't be countered — flexible answer at MV3 that can trigger on their turn (r2,r4,r9)

Alela, Artful Provocateur.text: Flying deathtouch lifelink (r5); "cast an artifact or enchantment spell → 1/1 flyer" doubles bodies with G'raha on every enchantment (r1,r6)

Eriette, the Beguiler.text: Steal clause needs Auras on opponents' permanents with MV ≥ target (Lawmage's Binding steals MV≤3); aura-density dependent, lifelink (r5)

Queza, Augur of Agonies.text: "Whenever you draw a card… lose 1, you gain 1" — steady life refill (r5); pairs with Ephara/Y'shtola draws; creature

Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.text: "Noncreature spell MV 3+ → 2 damage, gain 2" refunds the X life (r5); paying X≥4 life to G'raha self-triggers her end-step draw (r4)

Chromium, the Mutable.text: Flash uncounterable 7-drop flyer; no engine interaction and 7 MV creature crowds the curve (r1,r4)

Shattered Seraph.text: {2} exile-from-hand fixing is an activation, not a cast; the later cast is a creature spell (r1); 3 life on ETB only

The Ur-Sphinx.text: 9-MV creature with no Sphinx density; free casts of milled cards rarely land before the game is decided (r4)

Stormkeld Curator // Giant Secrets.text: Giant Secrets is an INSTANT {X}{U}{U}: X=2 is MV4 → 5/5 Hero on their turn + 2 cards (r2,r4); Curator body re-buys auras late

Lawmage's Binding.text: FLASH aura "can't attack or block, abilities can't be activated" — instant-speed removal that triggers on their turn (r2,r9)

Eagle's Rescue.text: +2/+2 flying aura at MV4 (r1); graveyard return is an activation onto power ≤1 — only an X=0 Hero qualifies (r6), so recursion rarely live

Dance of the Manse.text: X counts on the stack: MV X+2 sizes the Hero (r4); returns non-Aura enchantments ≤X — good if the 99 is enchantment-dense

Eriette of the Charmed Apple.text: End-step drain X = Auras you control (r5); Scriv's Contract tokens count; needs aura density the 99 may not have

Killian, Decisive Mentor.text: Enchantment ETB taps+goads (tempo); draw when aura'd creatures attack — needs auras on own attackers; creature (r1)

Glasswing Grace // Age-Graced Chapel.text: MDFC: land when needed, else MV5 aura "+2/+2, flying and lifelink" — on a Hero token turns it into a lifelink fuel source (r5,r6)

Scriv, the Obligator.text: Flying deathtouch; Contract tokens make their attackers "lose 2 life" in 1v1 — drain-style pressure; tokens are Auras for Eriette (r5)

Rise to Glory.text: MV5 sorcery reanimating a creature and an Aura (r1); fine value but slow and graveyard-dependent; 5 life for the Hero (r4)

Archnemesis.text: MV3 aura on opponent: each attack "loses 2… you draw a card and gain 2 life" — Hero attackers make it card + life every turn (r4,r5)

Coerced to Kill.text: Sorcery-speed steal "You control enchanted creature" as a 1/1 deathtouch — removal that adds a blocker (r9); MV5 life cost (r4)

Zur, Eternal Schemer.text: Enchantment creatures get deathtouch, lifelink, hexproof; {1}{W} animates non-Aura enchantments (MV-sized bodies) — enchantment-deck value

Tameshi, Reality Architect.text: Sorcery activation returns artifact/enchantment ≤X by bouncing a land — slow recursion, not a cast (r1)

Inquisitive Glimmer.text: "Enchantment spells cost {1} less" — MV is unchanged so the Hero size and X life are the same (r4); pure ramp, creature

Wingbright Thief.text: 2-MV flyer; perpetual "opponent draws and gains 3" tax on one of their cards is minor; creature (r1)

Ephara, God of the Polis.text: "Each upkeep, if another creature entered under your control last turn, draw" — a Hero on each turn (r2) = a card on BOTH upkeeps; indestructible

Knights' Charge.text: Drain only "whenever a Knight attacks" — only Paladin's Arms makes Knights here (r6 count ≈ 1); MV3 trigger is its only value

Doom Foretold.text: Symmetric "sacrifices a nonland, nontoken permanent" each upkeep eats OUR commander/enchantments; Hero tokens don't satisfy it — fights the engine

Dramatic Finale.text: "Creature tokens you control get +1/+1" = anthem for every Hero (r6); 2/1 flyer on nontoken death; hybrid cost easy (r7)

Firja's Retribution.text: MV4 Saga: 4/4 flyer, then a creature-kill tap ability (r9), then double strike — three chapters of value plus the trigger (r1,r4)

Neva, Stalked by Nightmares.text: Menace; ETB regrows a creature or enchantment; grows + scry when an enchantment (Sagas, Sieges) leaves — card advantage body

Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky.text: ETB reanimates any nonbattle permanent; flipped "creature tokens get +1/+0 and have lifelink" turns every Hero into fuel (r5,r6)

Naomi, Pillar of Order.text: Samurai tokens only "if you control an artifact and an enchantment"; MV5 creature (r1) with a condition to count

Athreos, Shroud-Veiled.text: Creature SPELL on the stack (no trigger, r1); coin-counter recursion is slow value; devotion 7 unlikely

Rampage of the Valkyries.text: MV5 enchantment: 4/4 flying vigilance Angel + edict whenever an Angel dies; Firja's Angel also qualifies (r1,r9)

Ethereal Absolution.text: "+1/+1 ours, -1/-1 theirs" anthems every Hero and wipes opposing 1/1s (r6,r9); MV6 = 6 life for the Hero (r4)

Rogue Class.text: MV2 cast trigger; levels are activations, not casts (r1); Hero attackers exile/play their cards — slow

Saruman of Many Colors.text: "Second spell each turn" → free copy of their instant/sorcery/enchantment = a free noncreature cast; ward-discard; 6-drop creature (r1)

Obscura Ascendancy.text: Needs spells at MV 1,2,3,4,5 in sequence for Spirits; MV3 cast trigger itself (r1); Spirit anthem doesn't hit Heroes (r6)

Leyline of Hope.text: "+1 per lifegain" pads lifelink (r5); the +2/+2 needs 7 over starting life, which X-payments make rare; free on turn 0 skips the cast

Leyline of Anticipation.text: "Cast spells as though they had flash" — every noncreature spell can trigger on their turn, doubling tokens per round (r2)

Leyline of Transformation.text: Choose Hero: every creature is a Hero for Captain America/Hero payoffs (r6) — value scales with Hero-payoff count, does nothing alone

Black Panther, Most Dangerous.text: Hero; damage-reflection body; power-up {5}{W}{W} team pump is an activation, not a cast (r1)

Captain America, Wings of Freedom.text: "Each other Hero you control gets +X/+X" (X = toughness 3) on attack — every G'raha token is a Hero (r6); flying, first strike, ward

Hawkeye, Bowslinger.text: Hero; "cast a spell that targets a creature" → counter + scry — auras and removal fire it (r6)

Quake, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D..text: Hero; "whenever you cast a noncreature spell, tap target creature or land" with NO once-per-turn cap — tempo off every spell (r1,r2)

Paladin's Arms.text: MV3 cast = G'raha Hero + Job-select Hero (two bodies, r1,r6); +2/+1 ward 1; equip {4} is clunky

Aerith Rescue Mission.text: "Create three 1/1 colorless Hero tokens" + G'raha's = 4 Heroes (r6) or tap three + stun (r9); MV4 sweet spot (r4)

Mockingbird, Ace Agent.text: Hero, double strike; counters only on spells targeting her — needs own-targeting auras; creature (r1)

The Sentry, Golden Guardian.text: ETB gives the opponent a 5/5 flying INDESTRUCTIBLE Void — hands them a threat our removal can't kill; Hero tag isn't worth it

White Widow, Free Agent.text: Hero; ETB +1/+1 counters on two creatures (r6) or regrow an artifact/enchantment card — flexible value

Captain America, Steve Rogers.text: Lifelink (r5) and "+1/+1 counter on another target creature" on attack grows a Hero token (r6); a 5-drop creature that adds no trigger (r1).

Doctor Strange, Surgeon.text: "If you would gain life, you gain twice that much": doubles G'raha's lifelink and every drain (r5). Reaching 35 life gives "+2/+2 and vigilance" to a go-wide Hero board (r6).

Doctor Spectrum.text: The ETB "+1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control" scales with the commander's tokens (r6); the "destroy target enchantment" mode is a flexible answer (r9).

Photon, Lady of Light.text: Fights the engine: "exile … then return that card" kills a Hero TOKEN outright, and blinking a real creature wipes its counters (r6, G-42).

Wondrous Revival.text: "Up to three target Hero creature CARDS": tokens never reach the yard as cards, so it needs real Heroes (9 in this part). MV 6 means a 7/7 for 6 life (r4).

Secret Identity.text: 1-mana instant that triggers on the opponent's turn (r2). Conceal gives hexproof and saves a pumped token from removal; Reveal makes a 3/4 flyer. Only a small body (r4).

Wiccan, Rising Magician.text: "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, exile another target nonland, nontoken permanent" until end step: a blocker or blink every spell, with no once-per-turn cap (r1, r3).

The Mighty Thor, Jane Foster.text: Esper 3-drop flyer. The attack trigger "exile … nontoken artifact or creature … return tapped" clears a blocker (r9 tempo), and "Equipment enters, draw" pairs with Lance and Sword.

Abigale, Poet Laureate // Heroic Stanza.text: Becomes prepared only on a "creature spell" cast (G'raha's tokens aren't cast). The copy of the sorcery half (+1/+1 counter, MV 2) does trigger r1, but the deck is noncreature-heavy (r3).

Plaza of Heroes.text: Its any-colour mana is spendable "only to cast a legendary spell" (the commander qualifies, r7), and "{3},{T}, exile: hexproof and indestructible" protects G'raha.

Slumbering Keepguard.text: "Whenever an enchantment you control enters, scry 1" plus a pump per enchantment: live with this part's aura density, but a 1-drop body that adds no trigger (r1).

Dragoon's Lance.text: Job select "create a 1/1 colorless HERO token": with the commander, one MV-2 spell makes two Hero bodies (r1, r4, r6). Flying on your turn.

Danitha, Sword of Hope.text: "Equipment spell or a spell that targets a creature you control, draw a card", once each turn. Every Aura qualifies, so it draws about once a turn here (r3).

Fiendslayer Paladin.text: First strike and lifelink is modest fuel (r5). Otherwise a vanilla 3-drop creature (r1).

History of Benalia.text: MV-3 noncreature Saga (r1, r4): two 2/2 vigilance Knights plus a Hero token, then "Knights +2/+1". Three bodies from one card.

Dion, Bahamut's Dominant // Bahamut, War.text: ETB 2/2 Knight. The back face's "+1/+1 counter on each other creature" stacks on Heroes (r6) and Gigaflare is removal. The {4}{W}{W} transform is slow.

The Circle of Loyalty.text: Legendary artifact: "Creatures you control get +1/+1" on a token board (r6), and a Knight on each "legendary spell" (the commander too). Affinity cuts its cost, not its MV, so X stays 6 (r4).

Voracious Vampire.text: Its ETB pumps only "target Vampire you control"; there is no Vampire spine. A 2/2 menace creature with no trigger (r1).

Marshal of Zhalfir.text: "Other Knights +1/+1": Hero tokens aren't Knights unless they hold the Lance. The tap ability is mild tempo.

Summon: Primal Odin.text: Its Enchantment Creature type makes it a CREATURE spell, so no trigger (r1). Chapter I "Destroy target creature" plus chapter III "Draw two" is real interaction (r9); the 2 life loss is minor (r5).

Arvad the Cursed.text: Deathtouch and lifelink (r5). "Other legendary creatures +2/+2" misses Hero tokens (not legendary) unless they carry Super-Soldier Serum.

Squall, SeeD Mercenary.text: "Attacks alone … double strike" works against a go-wide Hero board (r6). Recursion of a permanent with MV 3 or less is the upside.

Adeline, Resplendent Cathar.text: "Power equal to the number of creatures you control" scales with the commander's tokens (r6), and it makes a 1/1 on each attack. A strong card, but no trigger (r1).

Brigone, Soldier of Meletis.text: Heroic counter plus "remove a counter: draw" wants spells that target it. Many Auras do, but it's a 2-drop body.

Captain America, Super-Soldier.text: "You and other Heroes you control have hexproof" while it keeps its shield: every commander token is a Hero (r6), and the life total is protected too (r5).

Captain America, Unbowed.text: Flash, then "Soldiers and Heroes you control gain indestructible": an instant-speed wrath answer for a Hero-token board (r6, r9). It is a creature, so no trigger.

Captain America, Skybound.text: Battalion "+1/+1 counter on each attacking creature" plus indestructible fits a wide Hero board (r6). A 5-drop with no trigger (r1).

Lyra, Archangel of Dawn.text: "Whenever you gain life, +1/+1 counter on each ANGEL": Hero tokens aren't Angels except under Angelic Destiny, so its lifegain hook rarely pays (r5).

Champions of Tyr.text: The one-time boon fires only on a "creature spell" cast. The deck wants noncreature density (r3).

Lulu, Forgetful Hollyphant.text: The one-time boon gives flying to a creature SPELL. Tokens aren't cast, so it misses the engine (r1, r3).

Serra Redeemer.text: "Another creature with power 2 or less enters → two +1/+1 counters": a Hero token enters as a 1/1 before G'raha's counters, so every token gets +2 (r6). Same for the Lance token and Knights.

Greater Auramancy.text: Shroud for enchantments and enchanted creatures protects the Aura pile. A cheap trigger (r4), but no effect on the board.

Kor Spiritdancer.text: "Whenever you cast an Aura spell, you may draw": good only with heavy Aura density (this part has ~17). It's a creature (r1).

Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice.text: A cast Aura tutors a second Aura of equal or lower MV onto Light-Paws. It needs the deck built as Auras, and it's a creature (r1).

Petrify.text: MV-2 Aura removal, "can't attack or block … activated abilities can't be activated", plus a 3/3 Hero token (r1, r4, r9). Sorcery speed.

Sheltered by Ghosts.text: O-Ring "exile target nonland permanent" (r9) plus "lifelink and ward {2}" on a Hero token (r5, r6), all at MV 2 (r4).

Sentinel's Mark.text: Flash Aura: a noncreature spell on the opponent's turn for a second token per round (r2). "+1/+2, vigilance"; main-phase casts add lifelink (r5).

Skyblade's Boon.text: "{2}{W}: Return to hand", from the battlefield OR the graveyard: a repeatable MV-2 noncreature cast every turn, i.e. a 3/3 Hero each turn (r1, r3, r4).

Spectral Steel.text: "+2/+2", and its graveyard ability buys back another Aura or Equipment. A cheap trigger (r4).

Sram, Senior Edificer.text: "Whenever you cast an Aura, Equipment, or Vehicle spell, draw a card", with no per-turn cap: the card-advantage engine for this part's Aura/Equipment package.

Super-Soldier Serum.text: "+2/+2, first strike, vigilance, legendary Soldier": makes a Hero token legendary, so Arvad pumps it and Cap Unbowed protects it. Mostly a cheap trigger (r4).

Transcendent Envoy.text: Enchantment Creature: a creature spell. "Aura spells cost {1} less" leaves X intact (MV unchanged), but it's a 2/2-ish flyer with no trigger.

Acclaimed Contender.text: Its ETB digs for "a Knight, Aura, Equipment, or legendary artifact" but needs another Knight. A creature (r1).

Born to Drive.text: "+1/+1 for each creature" on a wide board (r6). Channel makes two Pilots, but Channel is an activated ability, not a cast, so no trigger.

Danitha Capashen, Paragon.text: First strike, vigilance and lifelink (r5). "Aura and Equipment spells cost {1} less" speeds up the package without lowering MV, so X is intact (r4).

Due Diligence.text: "+2/+2, vigilance" plus a one-turn +2/+2. Vanilla pump at MV 3 that adds only the trigger (r1).

Hope Against Hope.text: "+1/+1 for each creature you control" scales with the commander's tokens (r6). An aggro Aura that adds a trigger.

Light of Promise.text: "Whenever you gain life, put that many +1/+1 counters": on lifelinked G'raha, or with Doctor Strange doubling, every hit grows it (r5, r6).

One Last Job.text: Spree reanimation (creature, or Aura/Equipment attached). MV is 3 whatever modes you pay, so a 4/4 token (r4). Sorcery.

Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor.text: Draws when "an Aura spell targets a MODIFIED permanent". Every Hero token carries counters and so counts as modified (r6). Lifelink (r5), plus Aura affinity.

Nahiri's Binding.text: Pacifism for a "creature or planeswalker" with activated abilities locked (r9), plus a 4/4 Hero (r1, r4). Sorcery speed.

Pariah.text: "All damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to enchanted creature": shields the life budget (r5). Best on an indestructible or large Hero token.

Angelic Destiny.text: "+4/+4, flying, first strike", returns to hand when the creature dies so you can recast it for another trigger (r1). Makes the creature an Angel for Lyra.

Commanding Presence.text: "+2/+2, first strike" plus a Soldier token on combat damage. MV 4 for a 5/5 Hero (r4), but a mid-power Aura.

Friendly Neighborhood.text: "Create three 1/1 … Citizen tokens" plus a 5/5 Hero: four bodies from one MV-4 noncreature spell (r1, r4, r6). The pump land stays as a mana sink.

Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Re.text: Modal DFC: Sword (MV 2, noncreature) for the trigger and recursion (r1, r4), or Halvar for "enchanted or equipped creatures have double strike" on the Aura board.
